description:
Cats Hidden in Bali is a cute hidden object game set in Bali, Indonesia.

100 cats are waiting for you to be discovered within a hand-drawn background. Relax, thanks to the chill soundtrack.

Found a cat? Press on it!

Features
1 Level, 100 cats
Easter Eggs
Hint System
Timer mode with leaderboard
In-game Settings
name: Cats Hidden in Bali
intro: Find and discover 100 cute cats hidden across Bali in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?
